system.description:
Quantum torpedoes are a recent development by the Federation, though others have made similar developments. They’re more powerful than photon torpedoes, though the way they achieve this is classified. They have a base Damage of 4 Challenge Dice Vicious 1, with the Calibration and High-Yield Qualities.

Calibration: The weapon requires careful calibration before firing. The weapon cannot be used to attack unless a Prepare Minor Action is performed during the same Turn.

High-Yield: The weapon inflicts massive damage to enemy vessels; if the Attack inflicts one or more Breaches to a system, it inflicts one additional Breach.
